elements.element: Contractor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause requires comprehensive general liability coverage of at least USD 1,000,000 but does not state that this is a per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: Contractor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
Contractor must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional errors and omissions coverage.

elements.element: If Contractor processes Customer Data, Contractor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The data-processing condition is not demonstrably absent, and the added operative language requires only USD 2,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability coverage.

elements.element: Contractor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The clause requires workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: Contractor must provide certificates of insurance upon Company's request.
elements.evidence: The clause permits Contractor to provide certificates or other acceptable evidence of insurance or self-insurance, so certificates are not unconditionally required. In addition, “the above coverage” may exclude the cyber coverage added afterward.

elements.element: Contractor must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Contractor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence expressly requires cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The rendered clause reaches the stated fallback E&O and cyber limits but not the preferred E&O or cyber limits. It also omits the required CGL per-occurrence and aggregate designations and does not strictly guarantee certificates on request. The amendment is otherwise minimal and preserves the existing commercial terms, though placing cyber coverage after the reference to “the above coverage” creates avoidable ambiguity about whether evidence must include cyber insurance.
